summary: Staff can create promo offers that apply at membership checkout, with redemption audit and safe rejection of invalid codes.
detailed_changes: Added offers and offer_redemptions with optional Stripe test-mode coupons and promotion codes.
Account checkout accepts an offer code; expired, inactive, or exhausted codes are rejected before creating a session.
Successful checkout webhooks record one redemption per member and update redemption counts.
affected_areas: User groups affected: staff; public members
Public impact: optional promo codes at paid checkout
Internal impact: no live Stripe charge authorization
